column1: # Category shelf for the site.  Columns are separated by a TAB.
#   1) CATEGORY NAME  - shown on the site
#   2) FILTER WORDS   - separated by |  (a title containing any of them lands here)
#   3) SPLIT BY       - how to divide the category into sections:
#   4) ORDER BY       - how to order shiurim inside a section:
# If ORDER BY is מספר but the numbers repeat inside a section, that section
# falls back to date order on its own and says so in the report.
# When a title matches more than one category, the LONGEST filter word wins.
# The row with no filter words is the catch-all for titles matching nothing.
# A section with fewer than 3 episodes is folded back into the main list.
